narrationTexts: I'll start by exploring the codebase structure.
finalText:
**Big but shallow. 1291 hits, 94 files.**

Only `services` should change. That is 75 files, one repeated shape.

| Zone | Hits | Why frozen |
|---|---|---|
| [`docs/openapi.yaml`](docs/openapi.yaml) | 5 | Public API contract |
| [`lib/serialize.js`](lib/serialize.js:8) WIRE values | 1 | Wire names, frozen |
| [`migrations/*.sql`](migrations) | 61 | All 12 applied in prod |
| [`vendor/reporting-sdk`](vendor/reporting-sdk) | 20 | Generated, overwritten |

125 service hits are SQL column names. Those need a new forward migration.

Next: ask them to split the PR.
